integrity: Analytic proof with exact contact measures; finite numerical checks are supplemental.
scientific_limitations: Two full-dimensional balls in Euclidean space, n >= 2; excludes tangencies and non-Euclidean balls. Todd (2007) directly mentions the same outer-ellipsoid problem, creating material historical-priority uncertainty for the explicit phase formulas; no independent audit.
title: A sharp three-phase Löwner-ellipsoid law for the intersection of unequal Euclidean balls
